name: machine-duplicate-proofstory-diagnostic-input
title: core/machine.ts keeps a private copy of proofStoryDiagnosticInput that never resolves the story workspace
description: packages/main/src/core/machine.ts around lines 156 to 186 has its own proofStoryDiagnosticInput and proofStoryDevGateFailure reading context.store and context.projectRoot directly, while packages/main/src/handlers/phase-gates.ts's copy now resolves the story workspace first after B-77e6. Same fact, two resolution strategies, and the audit fixture cannot see it because it scans handlers only. The machine copy sits on the REVIEW/TEST to DEV re-entry guard and is pinned by literal text in scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs. Filed as B-77e6:F-007 and routed here because it is outside that story's scope contract.
